decision_summary: Self-review confirms v0.6.29 makes CRD-UNCERTAINTY structurally satisfiable without converting repeated measurements into a quality claim.
rationale: Visionary: the release exposes nondeterminism and infrastructure context before score interpretation. Builder: schema, verifier, readiness CLI, example, positive regression, and 20 retained negative cases cover links, arithmetic, status, confounders, and governance. Guardian: examples remain provisional; exact comparison is forbidden; observed ranges are not labeled statistical confidence intervals; sufficient status requires empirical origins and bounded stable infrastructure.
recommendation: Proceed to final council review after public-residue and organization checks.
